title: Two men arrested after Louvre jewel heist
summary: Two suspects in their 30s detained on Saturday evening in relation to €88m robbery, according to Paris prosecutor Two suspects have been arrested in relation to last Sunday’s heist at the Louvre museum in Paris, in which a gang of four men made off with crown jewels worth an estimated €88m (£76m), according to the Paris prosecutor. Citing police sources, Le Parisien newpaper said on Sunday that the men, both in their 30s and from Seine St-Denis outside the French capital, were detained on Saturday evening as part of an investigation by the Paris organised crime squad. title: Your Crypto Isn’t Safe Outside the Blockchain, Vitalik Buterin Warns
summary: Vitalik Buterin emphasized that blockchain's cryptographic safeguards protect on-chain funds from validator collusion but offer no protection for off-chain activities like oracles or restaking that depend on validator honesty rather than protocol enforcement. The post Your Crypto Isn’t Safe Outside the Blockchain, Vitalik Buterin Warns appeared first on Cryptonews .

title: Russia arrests Ukrainian biologist for backing curbs on Antarctic krill fishing
summary: ‘Trumped-up’ charges spark diplomatic row as scientists express fears for health of 70-year-old Leonid Pshenichnov Antarctic krill: how did a paperclip-sized crustacean cause a diplomatic row – and why are they so important? A diplomatic row has erupted over the “illegal” detention of one of Ukraine’s scientists, who has been accused by the Kremlin of undermining Russia’s industrial trawling for krill in Antarctica. Leonid Pshenichnov, 70, a Ukrainian biologist who is an expert on Antarctica, has a decades-long record of scientific research and contributions to conservation, including support for marine protected areas in the region.
